title: Talking-Head Method (Gardner)
text: Host/talking-head clips HAMESHA media.generate_video se banao (still image + zoom MANA hai). Character consistency: pehle ONE master reference image (front-facing, direct eye contact, us doc ka costume), phir HAR clip usi reference se generate karo. Background: detective desk + evidence board (notes/photos) + red accent light — har clip me SAME. Camera: 20+ alag angles, har clip me different movement (push-in/pull-back/lateral/static/handheld-drift). Expression hamesha scene-mood ke hisab se.
